name: Maps
description: A map of the places your room cares about: add places by clicking, pasting coordinates or a map link, and see the places other modules' items carry.
author: Coffee Pub

permissions.label: See the map and its places

settings.label: Map file
settings.help: A PMTiles map file (a region or the world) you copied into the module-files/maps folder in the data folder. Nothing is shown until one is chosen.

settings.label: Search address
settings.help: Optional. The address of a Photon-compatible place search that you run or may use, over https (for example https://search.example.org/api). Leave it empty for a map without search.
